name: OpenCadence
description: Workspace for freelancers to manage clients, projects, tasks, follow-ups and notes

paths.name: Data
paths.description: Your workspace (cadence.sqlite), backups made with the backup script, and icestore-password.txt. Back up this folder: it holds your client information and notes.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: OpenCadence, behind a password, published on host as 6195

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: USERNAME
variables.description: The user name your browser asks for before OpenCadence opens.

variables.name: PASSWORD
variables.description: The password your browser asks for. Leave it blank and the app makes a random one, shown in the app log in the box marked CREDENTIALS and saved as icestore-password.txt in the data folder.
